north_star.headline: Be a hub, not a leaf
north_star.body: Type a note on any card and hit Send — it emails earthbot. Visibility into every live area of operation. Navy career pays the bills; this layer is life admin through one personal OS.

items.title: Health data pipe (Health Auto Export → iCloud → Air)
items.status_text: Round 1 live. Week test through ~Nov 7. Day parser/sheet next.
items.detail: Sleep to iCloud (6 sleep metrics, hourly) lands on the Air in iCloud~com~ifunography~HealthExport/Documents/Sleep to iCloud/. Daily 9 AM sleep ingest reads from there — no more Google reconnect alarms. Sleep log complete Oct 24–31 (Oct 25 6.9 h, Oct 27 8.5 h backfilled). Day to iCloud (steps, distance, flights, walking speed/step length/asymmetry/double support/steadiness, weight, heart rate, breathing disturbances, AFib) exported Jan 1 2025–Oct 31 2026 (~669 files); Air downloading and copying to ~/HealthExports/day. Next: one-week hands-free daily files through ~Nov 7; Day parser + sheet tab; Home Screen widget later; round 2 = export everything, keep what has data.
